integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only the estimator definition, Gaussian integration, continuity, and a positive-probability neighborhood argument. The divergence of the source's displayed variance integral is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the direct proof.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes only the global unweighted time-integrated consistency claim. It does not address fixed-time consistency, compact-interval uniform consistency, or a weighted-time MISE with finite total weight.
title: Global MISE divergence for a generalized past-entropy kernel estimator
